title: Use the CLI's native --json-schema for all helper JSON calls
source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/structured-outputs + https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs — verified locally: `claude --help` on installed CLI 2.1.267 lists `--json-schema <schema>` ("JSON Schema for structured output validation")
description: `_call_helper_json()` (scripts/delegate.py:1463) still uses 2024-era prompt-engineering for structure: it appends a prose instruction ('Respond with ONLY valid JSON — no prose, no markdown'), then regex-scrapes `\{.*\}` out of stdout, and on a parse miss re-runs the ENTIRE subprocess a second time (doubling latency and cost). The installed CLI supports grammar-level `--json-schema`, and scripts/schemas.py already defines the exact schemas (ROUTING_DECISION_SCHEMA, SPRINT_PLAN_SCHEMA, DELEGATE_OUTPUT_SCHEMA, MEESEEKS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA). Moving from 'ask nicely + regex' to schema-constrained decoding removes the most common silent failure in the orchestrator: a helper returning None, which currently degrades to fail-open defaults (routing falls back, review auto-approves).
proposed_changes: 1) Add `_check_claude_json_schema_support()` mirroring the existing `_check_claude_output_format_json_support()` probe (grep `--json-schema` in `claude --help`), cached in a module global. 2) Give `_call_helper_json(prompt, model, timeout, schema: Optional[dict] = None)` a schema param; when a schema is passed AND supported, invoke `['claude','-p','--model',m,'--output-format','json','--json-schema',json.dumps(schema),'--',prompt]` and read the `result` field, skipping the prose json_suffix and the blind second `_run()` retry. Keep the current prose+regex path as the fallback for older CLIs. 3) Pass schemas at every call site: ROUTING_DECISION_SCHEMA (delegate.py ~line 893), a new AGENT_SCORING_SCHEMA (~line 963), SPRINT_PLAN_SCHEMA (~line 2190), and a new REVIEW_VERDICT_SCHEMA in schemas.py (`{approved: bool, issues: [str]}`, `additionalProperties: false`) for review_ticket (~line 2311). 4) Add `additionalProperties: false` to the existing schema dicts in schemas.py — the docs require it for strict validation — and keep `validate_schema()` as the post-parse guard for constraints the grammar can't express (enum ranges, string length). 5) Follow-up (separate ticket, do not bundle): apply DELEGATE_OUTPUT_SCHEMA to the worker subprocess so `<result_json>` regex extraction and `_reformat_retry_haiku()` become dead code.
last_error: Evolve timed out after 300s (flat default, pre-fix)
